How the money moves

Three ways to be paid,
one account.

Apply through us and the bank's acquisition budget comes back to you. Sell a perk you weren't going to use. Or bring other people in and take a cut. Each one feeds the next.

Engine A

Get paid to open the right product

Cards, savings accounts, health cover and loans from partner banks and insurers. We rank by what you'll actually be approved for, then share the commission with you.

Engine B

Reach an offer you don't hold the card for

Tell us the deal you're trying to reach. We'll either connect you to it, or show you the card that unlocks that offer and every one after it — free to join.

Engine C

Sell the perks you never use

Lounge visits and free movie tickets expire quietly every month. List yours and get paid, or buy someone else's for a fraction of the counter price.

Perks expire. Cash doesn't.

Why we'd rather sell you the card

If you're buying lounge access three times a year, you don't need us — you need a card that includes it. We'll tell you that, because a travel card is worth more to us than any single visit ever will be, and it leaves you better off. That's the whole model working as intended.

How we handle your money and data

The boring part,
written plainly.

Payouts

We pay after the bank pays us

Usually 60–75 days from approval, then within five days to you. It's slower than platforms that pay upfront, and it's the reason we can keep paying at all.

Money in transit

Held by a licensed partner

Funds for exchange purchases sit in escrow with an RBI-authorised payment aggregator until delivery is confirmed — never in our own account.

Your data

Used to match, never sold

Bureau and KYC data are used to check eligibility and complete your application. We don't sell it, and you can withdraw consent and delete your profile.

Approvals

No one can guarantee one

The bank decides, always. We improve your odds by not letting you apply for cards you're unlikely to get. Anyone promising guaranteed approval is lying to you.

Fees

Free to you, at every step

We're paid by banks, insurers and lenders. You're never charged to apply, and where we promise a joining fee waiver, we cover it up to the stated amount for the first year.

Agents

Certified, tracked, removable

Every agent is KYC-verified and trained before they can source a single application. Fraudulent activity means immediate removal and forfeited commission.

Card Crest is a distribution partner for banks, non-banking financial companies and insurers. We do not lend, issue cards or underwrite insurance. All approvals, credit limits, pricing and policy terms are decided solely by the issuing institution. Rewards are paid after the partner has settled and any clawback period has closed. Figures shown across this site are illustrations of the model, not offers, guarantees or forecasts. Insurance and lending products are offered through appropriately licensed partners.
